zh.name: 首席执行官（CEO）
zh.description: 企业最高决策者，掌管战略方向、资源配置、组织节奏与对外叙事——在信息不完备时做出可逆性分级的决策，对结果负最终责任，把愿景翻译成组织能执行的优先级。

zh.name: 首席财务官（CFO）
zh.description: 战略财务高管，掌管资本配置、资金运营、财务规划、并购财务、投资者关系与董事会汇报——把财务的复杂性转化为清晰决策，驱动业务表现并赢得各方利益相关者的信心。

zh.name: 首席营销官（CMO）
zh.description: 增长与品牌最高负责人，掌管定位、渠道组合、营销预算与品牌资产——用可归因的数字管增长，用不可量化的耐心管品牌，绝不让两者互相冒充。

zh.name: 幕僚长（Chief of Staff）
zh.description: 创始人和高管的首席协调者——过滤噪音、掌控流程、确保一致性、路由决策、将产出定位到最大影响处，让老板能清晰思考。

zh.name: 首席运营官（COO）
zh.description: 运营最高负责人，把战略翻译成流程、指标与执行节奏——消灭组织里的摩擦与例外，让正确的事成为默认发生的事，对"计划与现实的差距"负责。

zh.name: 首席产品官（CPO）
zh.description: 产品最高负责人，掌管产品战略、路线图取舍与产品组织——对"做什么、不做什么、按什么顺序做"负责，用用户价值与商业价值的交集裁决一切需求之争。

zh.name: 首席技术官（CTO）
zh.description: 技术最高负责人，掌管技术路线、架构决策、研发组织与技术债务——在业务速度与工程质量之间做显式权衡，让技术成为业务的杠杆而不是瓶颈。

zh.name: 品牌守护者
zh.description: 专精品牌形象开发、一致性维护和战略品牌定位的品牌策略师和品牌守护专家

zh.name: AI 工程师
zh.description: 精通机器学习模型开发与部署的 AI 工程专家，擅长从数据处理到模型上线的全链路工程化，专注构建可靠、可扩展的 AI 系统。

zh.name: 代码审查员
zh.description: 专业代码审查专家，提供建设性、可操作的反馈，聚焦正确性、可维护性、安全性和性能，而非代码风格偏好。

zh.name: 数据工程师
zh.description: 专注于构建可靠数据管线、湖仓架构和可扩展数据基础设施的数据工程专家。精通 ETL/ELT、Apache Spark、dbt、流处理系统和云数据平台，将原始数据转化为可信赖的分析就绪资产。

zh.name: 数据库优化师
zh.description: 数据库性能专家，专注于 Schema 设计、查询优化、索引策略和性能调优，精通 PostgreSQL、MySQL 及 Supabase、PlanetScale 等现代数据库。

zh.name: DevOps 自动化师
zh.description: 精通基础设施自动化、CI/CD 流水线开发和云运维的 DevOps 专家

zh.name: 钉钉集成开发工程师
zh.description: 专注钉钉开放平台全栈集成开发的工程专家，精通钉钉机器人、酷应用、审批流自动化、连接器低代码集成、钉钉小程序、宜搭平台对接及与阿里云生态的深度集成，擅长构建企业级协作与业务自动化解决方案。

zh.name: 嵌入式固件工程师
zh.description: 裸机和 RTOS 固件开发专家——精通 ESP32/ESP-IDF、PlatformIO、Arduino、ARM Cortex-M、STM32 HAL/LL、Nordic nRF5/nRF Connect SDK、FreeRTOS、Zephyr。

zh.name: 嵌入式 Linux 驱动工程师
zh.description: 嵌入式 Linux 内核驱动与 BSP 开发专家——精通 Linux 内核模块、设备树、Platform/I2C/SPI/USB 驱动框架、DMA、中断子系统、Yocto/Buildroot、U-Boot、交叉编译工具链。

zh.name: 飞书集成开发工程师
zh.description: 专注飞书开放平台全栈集成开发的工程专家，精通飞书机器人、小程序、审批流、多维表格（Bitable）、消息卡片、Webhook、SSO 单点登录及工作流自动化，擅长在飞书生态内构建企业级协作与自动化解决方案。

zh.name: FPGA/ASIC 数字设计工程师
zh.description: FPGA 与 ASIC 数字前端设计专家——精通 Verilog/SystemVerilog、VHDL、Vivado/Quartus、AXI/AHB 总线、时序收敛、Zynq/Intel SoC FPGA、高层次综合（HLS）。

zh.name: 故障响应指挥官
zh.description: 专精于生产环境故障管理、结构化响应协调、事后复盘、SLO/SLI 跟踪和 on-call 流程设计的事故指挥专家，为工程组织的可靠性保驾护航。

zh.name: IoT 方案架构师
zh.description: 物联网端到端方案设计专家——精通设备接入（MQTT/CoAP/LwM2M）、边缘计算、云平台（AWS IoT/Azure IoT/阿里云 IoT）、OTA、设备管理、数据管道和安全体系。

zh.name: IT 服务经理
zh.description: 资深 IT 服务管理（ITSM）专家，运用 ITIL 4 框架进行服务目录设计、incident（事件）与 problem（问题）管理、变更控制、SLA 治理、CMDB 维护以及持续服务改进——确保 IT 在任何规模的组织中都能交付可靠、可衡量的业务价值

zh.name: 机械设计工程师
zh.description: 通用机械产品设计专家——精通方案选型、传动/机构/结构件/连接设计、强度刚度疲劳振动校核、DFMA 与标准件选型，遵循 GB/ISO/JIS 国家标准，输出可制造可装配的工程图与 BOM。

zh.name: 国内网络工程师
zh.description: 面向国产网络设备的企业网工程专家——精通华为 VRP、华三 Comware、锐捷 RGOS，覆盖园区网/数据中心/广域网的 VLAN、STP、OSPF、IS-IS、BGP、MPLS、VXLAN、SDN 设计与排障，熟悉信创国产化替代与等保 2.0 合规组网。

zh.name: 上位机工程师
zh.description: Qt/QML 桌面上位机开发专家——精通 Qt Widgets/Quick、QSerialPort 串口、Modbus/CAN/TCP 工业协议、QChart/QCustomPlot 实时数据可视化，以及与 STM32/ESP32 等下位机的协议对接和跨平台打包部署。

zh.name: Prompt 工程师
zh.description: 专精于为 LLM（大语言模型）打磨、测试并系统化优化 prompt 的专家——把含糊的指令变成可靠、可上生产的 AI 行为。

zh.name: 安全工程师
zh.description: 专业应用安全工程师，专注于威胁建模、漏洞评估、安全代码审查、安全架构设计和事件响应，服务于现代 Web、API 和云原生应用。

zh.name: 高级开发者
zh.description: 精通 Laravel/Livewire/FluxUI 的高级全栈开发者，擅长高端 CSS 效果、Three.js 集成，专注打造有质感的 Web 体验。

zh.name: 软件架构师
zh.description: 软件架构专家，精通系统设计、领域驱动设计、架构模式和技术决策，构建可扩展、可维护的系统。

zh.name: SRE (站点可靠性工程师)
zh.description: 站点可靠性工程专家，精通 SLO、错误预算、可观测性、混沌工程和减少重复劳动，守护大规模生产系统的稳定性。

zh.name: 技术文档工程师
zh.description: 专精于开发者文档、API 参考、README 和教程的技术写作专家。把复杂的工程概念转化为清晰、准确、开发者真正会读也用得上的文档。

zh.name: 微信小程序开发者
zh.description: 专注微信小程序全栈开发的工程专家，精通 WXML/WXSS/WXS、微信原生API、微信支付集成、订阅消息、云开发，擅长在微信生态内构建高性能、体验流畅的小程序应用。

zh.name: 簿记与财务总监
zh.description: 专业簿记与财务总监，精通日常会计操作、财务对账、月末结账流程和内部控制。确保财务记录的准确性、完整性和时效性，始终保持 GAAP 合规和审计就绪状态。

zh.name: 财务分析师
zh.description: 专业财务分析师，精通财务建模、预测、场景分析和数据驱动的决策支持。将原始财务数据转化为可行动的商业智能，驱动战略规划、投资决策和运营优化。

zh.name: 财务预测分析师
zh.description: 专注企业财务预测与场景建模的分析专家，精通收入预测、现金流管理、烧钱率分析和融资对接，帮助创业公司和成长型企业在不确定环境中做出有数据支撑的财务决策。

zh.name: FP&A 分析师
zh.description: 专业财务规划与分析（FP&A）专家，精通预算编制、差异分析、财务规划、滚动预测和战略决策支持。在数字与业务叙事之间架起桥梁，驱动运营绩效和战略资源配置。

zh.name: 金融风控分析师
zh.description: 专注交易欺诈检测与金融风险防控的分析专家，精通支付宝/微信支付/银联渠道的风控策略、反洗钱合规、电信诈骗识别、央行征信应用和互联网金融风控体系搭建，帮助企业守住资金安全底线。

zh.name: 投资研究员
zh.description: 专业投资研究员，精通市场研究、尽职调查、投资组合分析和资产估值。通过严谨的基本面和量化分析识别投资机会、评估风险，支持数据驱动的投资组合决策，覆盖公开股票、私募市场和另类资产。

zh.name: 发票管理专家
zh.description: 专注中国企业发票全生命周期管理的财税专家，精通增值税专用发票与普通发票管理、金税系统操作、电子发票推广、三单匹配、报销审批和税务合规，帮助企业实现发票管理的规范化和数字化。

zh.name: 税务策略师
zh.description: 专业税务策略师，精通税务优化、多辖区合规、转让定价和战略税务规划。在确保完全合规的前提下，穿越复杂税法体系以最小化税负，覆盖地方、州、联邦和国际税务管辖区。

zh.name: 绩效管理专家
zh.description: 深耕中国企业绩效管理体系的实战专家，精通 OKR/KPI 双轨制、360 度反馈、绩效校准会、PIP 改进计划等全流程绩效管理，帮助企业建立科学公正的绩效评估与人才发展机制。

zh.name: 招聘专家（HR 全流程）
zh.description: 深耕中国人才市场的全流程招聘专家，精通 Boss 直聘、猎聘、拉勾等主流招聘渠道运营，擅长简历筛选、面试协调、人才管线管理、校招社招全链路操盘，帮助企业高效精准地完成人才获取与入职闭环。

zh.name: 合同审查专家
zh.description: 精通中国《民法典》合同编及商业合同实务的法律专家，擅长合同风险识别、条款审查与修改建议，熟悉电子签章、争议解决机制、违约金条款设计，帮助企业在商业交易中有效防控法律风险。

zh.name: 制度文件撰写专家
zh.description: 精通中国数据合规法律体系的企业制度文件撰写专家，擅长内部管理制度、隐私政策、用户协议等法律文书起草，深谙《个人信息保护法》《数据安全法》《网络安全法》三法合规要求，帮助企业构建完整的合规制度体系。

zh.name: 百度 SEO 专家
zh.description: 专注百度搜索生态的SEO优化专家，精通百度算法规则、百度生态产品矩阵（百科、知道、贴吧、文库）、中文关键词研究、ICP备案规范、以及移动端搜索优化策略。

zh.name: 内容创作者
zh.description: 擅长多平台内容策划与创作的内容专家，能在不同渠道用不同语言讲同一个好故事，让每一篇内容都带来可衡量的价值。

zh.name: 跨境电商运营专家
zh.description: 专注跨境电商全链路运营的策略专家，精通Amazon/Shopee/Lazada/AliExpress/Temu/TikTok Shop等海外平台运营、国际物流与海外仓、跨境合规税务、多语言Listing优化、品牌出海及DTC独立站建设。

zh.name: 新闻情报官
zh.description: 国内外多源新闻实时采集与结构化简报生成，为内容创作团队提供高质量新闻素材。支持按类型（科技/财经/社会/国际等）筛选，交叉验证信源，输出下游 agent 可直接使用的结构化简报。

zh.name: 抖音策略师
zh.description: 专注抖音平台的短视频营销专家，精通算法推荐机制、爆款视频策划、直播带货流程、以及通过内容矩阵实现品牌在抖音生态的全链路增长。

zh.name: 邮件营销策略师
zh.description: 资深邮件营销策略师，专注于 CRM 驱动的营销活动、生命周期自动化、分群架构与可送达性。基于 2025-2026 基准数据、AI 驱动的个性化以及后 Apple MPP 时代的衡量体系，设计各类序列（欢迎、培育、再激活、挽回、评价、转介绍）。

zh.name: LinkedIn 内容创作专家
zh.description: 专注于 LinkedIn 个人品牌打造和专业内容创作的策略师，深谙 LinkedIn 算法与社区文化，通过高质量内容为创始人、求职者、技术人和职场人带来真实的商业机会与人脉增长。

zh.name: PR 与传播经理
zh.description: 战略性公共关系与传播专家，负责 media relations（媒体关系）、press release（新闻稿）、crisis communications（危机传播）、高管思想领导力、品牌声誉管理与整合传播规划——通过 earned media（赢得式媒体）、故事化叙事和主动的叙事掌控来建立并守护声誉

zh.name: SEO专家
zh.description: 搜索引擎优化策略师，精通技术SEO、内容优化、外链权重建设和自然搜索增长，通过数据驱动的搜索策略实现可持续的流量增长。

zh.name: 短视频剪辑指导师
zh.description: 专注短视频剪辑技术全链路的实战教练，精通剪映/CapCut专业版、Premiere Pro、DaVinci Resolve、Final Cut Pro四大剪辑工具，覆盖画面构图与镜头语言、调色与色彩校正、音频工程、动态图形与特效、字幕排版、多平台输出优化、剪辑工作流效率提升以及AI辅助剪辑等核心技术领域。

zh.name: 社交媒体策略师
zh.description: 跨平台社交媒体策略专家，专注 LinkedIn、Twitter 等职业社交平台的品牌建设、社区运营和整合营销。

zh.name: 视频优化专家
zh.description: 视频营销策略师，精通 YouTube 算法优化、观众留存、章节设计、封面构思和跨平台视频分发。

zh.name: 微信公众号管理
zh.description: 微信公众号运营专家，精通内容营销、用户互动和转化优化，擅长多格式内容和自动化工作流，把公众号做成品牌私域核心阵地。

zh.name: 微信公众号运营
zh.description: 专注微信生态的内容运营专家，精通公众号内容策略、社群运营、裂变增长、私域流量搭建和微信小程序运营。

zh.name: 微信视频号运营策略师
zh.description: 专注微信视频号生态的内容策略与增长运营专家，精通社交推荐机制、公众号/朋友圈/小程序/企微生态联动、视频号直播带货、短视频内容策划、私域引流闭环和创作者数据分析。

zh.name: 知乎策略师
zh.description: 知乎营销专家，擅长思想领袖建设、社区公信力打造和知识驱动型互动，通过高质量问答和专栏建立品牌权威。

zh.name: 反馈分析师
zh.description: 专注用户反馈收集、分类和洞察提炼的产品分析专家，把碎片化的用户声音变成可执行的产品改进建议。

zh.name: 产品经理（PM）
zh.description: 全局型产品负责人，掌控产品全生命周期——从需求发现、战略规划到路线图制定、干系人对齐、GTM 落地与结果度量。在商业目标、用户需求与技术现实之间架起桥梁，确保在正确的时间交付正确的产品。

zh.name: 趋势研究员
zh.description: 专注行业趋势分析和技术前瞻的研究专家，帮团队看清未来 6-18 个月的方向，在正确的时间做正确的事。

zh.name: Jira工作流管家
zh.description: 交付运营专家，执行Jira关联的Git工作流，确保提交可追溯、PR结构规范、分支策略安全可控。

zh.name: 会议纪要专家
zh.description: 从会议 transcript（逐字记录）或零散笔记中提取结构化的决议、action item 和待解决问题，整理成清晰的四段式 summary。

zh.name: 项目牧羊人
zh.description: 专注跨部门项目协调、时间线管理和利益方对齐的项目管理专家，把项目从立项一路护送到交付，管好资源、风险和各方沟通。

zh.name: 高级项目经理
zh.description: 把规格说明书拆成可执行任务的资深 PM，记得住以前项目的经验教训，专注务实的范围控制和精确的需求还原。

zh.name: 客户拓展策略师
zh.description: 售后客户拓展专家，擅长 Land-and-Expand 执行、干系人关系图谱、QBR 策划及净收入留存率管理。通过系统化扩展规划和多线程客户关系经营，将成交客户发展为长期平台合作。

zh.name: 销售教练

skills.description_zh: 让 Claude 接上没有官方连接器的工具：先弄清该系统是什么，查 Claude 连接器目录中是否已有现成连接器，没有则通过 Zapier 接入（绝不手工对接原始 API），凭据安全处理，任何写操作都设审批关卡。它把「我的 ERP 不受支持」变成一个下午就能解决的事。当用户提到尚未连接的工具时使用，例如「能连到我的……吗」「让我的工具互相打通」「这个没有 API」「把现场服务软件的数据拉出来」「我用 ServiceTrade，不在列表里」「有没有办法拿到这些数据」，或某个不受支持的系统正阻碍其他工作时。

skills.name: business-pulse
skills.description: Produces a one-page cross-functional business snapshot for SMB owners — cash position (the ledger: MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), sales trend (PayPal/Square/Stripe), pipeline movement (HubSpot), this week's commitments (Calendar), urgent watch-list items (Gmail or M365, Slack), and the single most important thing needing attention today. Proactively tries every available connector and gracefully scopes to whatever is connected — one connector gives a partial pulse; the full stack gives the full picture. Trigger when the user asks how the business is doing, wants a snapshot, a daily brief, a Friday recap, or says anything like "what am I missing" or "catch me up on the business." A start-of-week briefing routes to /monday-brief, which runs this skill as its first link.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 为小微企业主生成一页跨职能经营快照：现金状况（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books 等账套）、销售趋势（PayPal/Square/Stripe）、销售漏斗变化（HubSpot）、本周日程（Calendar）、紧急关注事项（Gmail 或 M365、Slack），以及今天最需要处理的一件事。会主动尝试所有可用连接器，只接一个也能出局部快照，全部接上则给出完整画面。当用户问生意怎么样、要一份快照、每日简报、周五回顾，或说「我漏了什么」「帮我了解一下公司情况」时使用；周初简报走 /monday-brief，它会先运行这一技能。

skills.name: call-list
skills.description: Builds today's call list. Runs small-business-lead-triage to rank the top-5 leads most worth calling, supplies talking points from email history, blocks time on the calendar, and drafts follow-up messages. Trigger on "call list," "who am I calling today," "top five to call today," or "block time for calls." An owner who wants leads scored or ranked with no calendar blocks routes to small-business-lead-triage directly. Accepts optional count and date arguments.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 生成今天的电话名单：先运行 small-business-lead-triage 选出最值得打的前 5 条线索，从邮件历史提炼谈话要点，在日历上预留通话时间，并起草跟进消息。当用户说「电话名单」「今天该给谁打电话」「今天最该打的五个」「帮我留出打电话的时间」时使用；若只想给线索打分排序而不占用日历，直接用 small-business-lead-triage。支持可选的数量和日期参数。

skills.name: canva-creator
skills.description: Takes an approved content brief and executes a campaign end-to-end: builds the posting calendar, generates Canva designs for social posts, drafts caption and email copy, and stages social sends in HubSpot. Canva is used for social posts only (Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn) — email content is drafted as plain text and surfaced inline for the owner to send from their own tool. Every step requires explicit owner approval. This is the one-shot campaign executor: a finished brief goes in, a complete campaign comes out. Use when the owner hands off an approved brief or points at one — "run this brief," "execute the campaign," "turn this brief into posts," "build the campaign from the plan we approved." For day-to-day posting with no brief — "I need to post more," "what should we post" — use social-content-engine instead; it owns the standing calendar.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 接收一份已批准的内容简报并端到端执行整场活动：搭建发布日历，用 Canva 生成社交帖图，撰写文案和邮件内容，并在 HubSpot 中暂存社交发送。Canva 仅用于 Instagram、Facebook、X、LinkedIn 等社交帖子，邮件内容以纯文本呈现，由用户自行从自己的工具发送，每一步都需用户明确批准；这是一次性的活动执行器，输入成品简报，输出完整活动。当用户交来已批准的简报并说「跑这份简报」「执行这个活动」「把简报变成帖子」「按我们批准的计划做活动」时使用；没有简报的日常发帖（「我得多发点」「我们该发什么」）请用 social-content-engine。

skills.name: cash-flow-snapshot
skills.description: Reads AR/AP, historical cash timing, and known fixed costs from the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) or from PayPal, Square, or Stripe — or a CSV upload — and produces a 30/60/90-day cash flow forecast with percentage-variance confidence bands and named risk flags. Delivers a chat summary and a downloadable XLSX. Use when the user asks "forecast my cash flow," "will I make payroll," mentions "runway," or says "cash crunch." Falls back to CSV upload when no connector is live.
skills.compatibility: Requires one or more of: a ledger MCP (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books), PayPal MCP, Shopify MCP, Square MCP, Stripe MCP, file upload (CSV fallback). Output uses xlsx skill.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 从账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books）或 PayPal、Square、Stripe（也可上传 CSV）读取应收应付、历史现金节奏和已知固定成本，生成 30/60/90 天现金流预测，附百分比波动置信区间和具名风险提示，输出聊天摘要和可下载的 XLSX。当用户说「预测一下现金流」「发工资的钱够不够」，提到「还能撑多久」或「现金吃紧」时使用；没有连接器时改用 CSV 上传。

skills.name: close-month
skills.description: Closes the books and turns them into a decision as a three-link chain — month-end-prep reconciles the ledger against every connected payment processor and writes the P&L narrative, cash-flow-snapshot then refreshes the 30/60/90-day forecast off the newly closed numbers rather than raw ones, and report-builder publishes and distributes the close packet. Requires a ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) and uses Gusto, PayPal, Ramp, Shopify, Square, and Stripe when connected, falling back to statement or CSV uploads. Trigger on "close the month," "month-end," "close the books," "reconcile," "send the close packet to my accountant," or when the owner asks why revenue or margin moved last month. An owner who wants only the reconciliation and its flags, with no forecast refresh and no packet distribution, routes to month-end-prep directly.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 三步链式完成月结并转化为决策：month-end-prep 将账套与所有已连接的支付渠道对账并撰写损益说明，cash-flow-snapshot 再基于刚结账的数据刷新 30/60/90 天预测，最后由 report-builder 发布并分发月结资料包。需要账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books），已连接时会用到 Gusto、PayPal、Ramp、Shopify、Square、Stripe，否则改用对账单或 CSV 上传。当用户说「结一下月」「月末结账」「对账」「把月结资料发给会计」，或问上月收入、毛利为何变动时使用；只要对账和异常提示、不刷新预测也不分发的，直接用 month-end-prep。

skills.name: content-strategy
skills.description: Analyzes sales data from PayPal and QuickBooks to find top performers and slow movers, layers in seasonality, and produces a prioritized 30-day content brief: what to push, what offers to run, what to hold. Strategic output only — no calendars or assets. Use when the user asks what to post, wants a content plan, asks what's selling, or what to promote this month.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 分析 PayPal 和 QuickBooks 的销售数据，找出畅销品和滞销品，叠加季节性因素，输出一份按优先级排列的 30 天内容简报：该推什么、做什么促销、哪些先按兵不动。只给策略，不做日历和素材。当用户问该发什么内容、要一份内容计划、问什么卖得好或这个月该推广什么时使用。

skills.name: contract-review
skills.description: Lightweight NDA, MSA, and vendor contract review for SMBs without legal on staff. Reads contracts from local files, mail attachments (Gmail or M365), a connected file store (Google Drive or M365), or DocuSign envelopes; flags non-standard terms; explains risks in plain English; and outputs a marked-up redline as a separate DOCX. Use when the user says "review this contract," "what am I signing," "red flags," "flag any concerns," "check the payment terms," or uploads/forwards a contract or legal agreement.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 面向没有法务的小微企业，对 NDA、MSA 和供应商合同做轻量审查：从本地文件、邮件附件（Gmail 或 M365）、已连接的文件库（Google Drive 或 M365）或 DocuSign 信封中读取合同，标出非标准条款，用大白话解释风险，并另出一份带修订标记的 DOCX。当用户说「帮我看看这份合同」「我在签什么」「有没有坑」「标出需要注意的地方」「检查付款条款」，或上传、转发合同及法律协议时使用。

skills.name: crm-autopilot
skills.description: Keeps the CRM current without the owner ever opening it. Creates and updates contacts and deals from email, calendar, and call transcripts; logs activity automatically; drafts follow-ups on deals that have gone quiet; and maintains a next-step queue so nothing sits unowned. Runs on demand or on a schedule, includes a hygiene sweep for duplicates and stale records, and builds a lightweight CRM in a spreadsheet for owners who don't have one. Use this whenever CRM data or pipeline hygiene comes up — including phrasings like "update my CRM," "log this call," "clean up HubSpot," "clean up Salesforce," "add this to the deal," "turn my meeting into a deal note," "which deals have gone quiet," "I hate data entry," or "my pipeline is out of date." Reach for it when the owner describes a call or meeting worth recording, even without naming the CRM.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 让用户不用打开 CRM 也能保持数据最新：从邮件、日历和通话记录自动创建、更新联系人和商机，自动记录活动，为沉寂的商机起草跟进，并维护「下一步」队列确保事事有人管。可按需或定时运行，附带重复、过期记录的清理，没有 CRM 的用户可用表格搭一个轻量版。当用户说「更新我的 CRM」「记录这通电话」「清理 HubSpot」「清理 Salesforce」「把会议整理成商机备注」「哪些单子没动静了」「我讨厌录数据」「我的漏斗数据过时了」时使用；用户描述了值得记录的通话或会议时，即使没提 CRM 也可使用。

skills.name: grant-rfp-writer
skills.description: Finds grant and solicitation opportunities the organization actually qualifies for, runs a hard go/no-go before anyone starts writing, drafts the application or response from past submissions and real program data, and tracks every deadline and reporting obligation that follows an award. Built for nonprofits, government contractors, and education, and it filters daily feeds like SAM.gov or DIBBS down to the handful worth bidding. Runs on Google Drive or M365 with DocuSign and Calendar deepening it, and works from uploaded past submissions plus web research when nothing is connected. Use this whenever a funding or bidding opportunity is in play — including "find grants we qualify for," "should we bid this," "draft the response to this RFP," "we've got 50 solicitations to filter," "what's due on the federal grant," or "help me write the proposal narrative."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 为非营利组织、政府承包商和教育机构寻找真正符合资格的资助和招标机会，动笔前先做严格的投/不投评估，基于过往申报材料和真实项目数据起草申请书或应标书，并跟踪中标后的每个截止日和报告义务；还能把 SAM.gov、DIBBS 等每日信息流筛到少数值得投的几条。运行于 Google Drive 或 M365，DocuSign 和 Calendar 可增强，没有连接器时基于上传的历史材料加网络调研工作。当用户说「找我们符合条件的资助」「这个标要不要投」「起草这份 RFP 的回复」「有 50 个招标要筛」「帮我写项目陈述」时使用。

skills.name: grow-pipeline
skills.description: Fills the funnel end to end without the owner babysitting it — reads the market and the competition for context, builds a ranked list of named prospects with a reason attached to each, writes personalized outreach in the owner's own voice, and logs every touch to the CRM. Chains lead-finder, outreach-composer, and crm-autopilot behind a web-native market read, with an owner approval at every handoff. Use this whenever the owner wants more pipeline rather than one specific piece of it, including phrasings like "I need more leads," "fill my funnel," "who should I be calling and what do I say," "find me customers like my best ones and reach out," "build me a prospect list and write the emails," or "sales has gone quiet, get something moving." Reach for it when the owner describes wanting new business generally rather than asking for a list or a single email.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 不用用户盯着就能端到端填满销售漏斗：先读市场和竞争情况作为背景，建立每条都附理由的潜在客户排名清单，以用户口吻撰写个性化触达，并把每次接触记入 CRM。它在网络市场调研之上串联 lead-finder、outreach-composer 和 crm-autopilot，每个交接点都需用户批准。适用于用户想要更多商机而非其中某一环的情况；当用户说「我需要更多线索」「填满我的漏斗」「该给谁打电话、说什么」「找些像我最好客户的公司并联系他们」「建一份潜客清单并写好邮件」「销售没动静了，推一把」时使用。

skills.name: growth-pulse
skills.description: Answers one question for an SMB owner — is the growth engine actually working? Pulls sales trend by channel, funnel conversion, campaign return, best and worst performing products, and customer sentiment from whatever is connected, then ends with the three growth actions worth taking this week. The growth-side twin of business-pulse, which covers the finance side. Use this whenever the owner asks how marketing or sales is performing, whether a campaign paid off, where leads are coming from, why the pipeline is stalling, which products are moving, or says anything like "is my marketing working," "growth check," "how's the funnel," or "where should I put my money next month." Reach for it even when the owner names a single channel rather than growth overall.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 只回答一个问题：增长引擎到底转不转？从已连接的数据源拉取分渠道销售趋势、漏斗转化、活动回报、表现最好和最差的产品及客户情绪，最后给出本周值得做的三件增长行动。它是 business-pulse（财务侧）在增长侧的孪生技能。当用户问营销或销售表现如何、某次活动是否值回票价、线索从哪来、漏斗为何停滞、哪些产品走俏，或说「我的营销有用吗」「增长体检」「漏斗怎么样」「下个月钱该投哪」时使用；即使只提到单个渠道也适用。

skills.name: hiring-screener
skills.description: Takes a pile of applications and turns it into a ranked shortlist, scored only against the job's stated rubric, with drafted replies to every candidate, scheduled interviews, and an onboarding checklist for whoever gets hired. Picks up where job-post-builder leaves off and carries the funnel through to first day, including the payroll setup handoff. Runs on Gmail and Google Calendar, deepens with Gusto, DocuSign, and Drive or M365, and works entirely from uploaded resumes with drafted replies the owner sends by hand. Use this whenever the owner has applicants to deal with — including phrasings like "I've got 40 resumes and no time," "who should I interview," "screen these applications," "help me narrow this down," "set up interviews for the top three," or "I need to tell the rest no." Reach for it when the owner mentions applicants, resumes, candidates, or being buried in a hiring inbox.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把一堆求职申请变成只按岗位评分标准打分的候选人排名短名单，附给每位候选人的回复草稿、面试安排，以及给录用者的入职清单（含工资系统交接）。承接 job-post-builder 的产出，把招聘漏斗一路推进到入职首日。运行于 Gmail 和 Google Calendar，Gusto、DocuSign、Drive 或 M365 可增强，也可仅基于上传的简历工作，回复由用户手动发送。当用户说「40 份简历没时间看」「该面谁」「筛一下这些申请」「帮我缩小范围」「给前三名安排面试」「我得拒掉其他人」，或提到求职者、简历、候选人、招聘邮箱爆满时使用。

skills.name: inbox-manager
skills.description: Turns a full inbox into a short, ranked list of what actually needs the owner. Reads the mail, sorts it into needs-you, drafted-and-waiting, and handled, writes replies in the owner's own voice, pulls out the action items and deadlines buried in long threads, files what is finished, and hands bills, leads, and scheduling requests to the skills that own them. Works from pasted or forwarded email text when no mailbox is connected. Use this whenever the owner mentions email at all — including "drowning in email," "I have 300 unread," "what emails need me," "go through my inbox," "clean up my email," "did I miss anything," "who am I supposed to get back to," "draft a reply to this," or "catch me up on my mail." Reach for it for one forwarded message as readily as for a whole morning's backlog.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把塞满的收件箱变成一份简短的、按优先级排列的「真正需要你处理」清单：读取邮件，分为需你处理、已起草待发、已处理三类，以用户口吻写回复，从长对话里提炼待办和截止日，归档已完成的，并把账单、线索和排期请求交给对应技能。没有连接邮箱时可处理粘贴或转发的邮件文本。当用户提到邮件时使用，例如「邮件淹死了」「300 封未读」「哪些邮件需要我」「帮我过一遍收件箱」「我漏了什么吗」「我该回谁」「帮我回这封」；单封转发邮件和一上午的积压都适用。

skills.name: inventory-planner
skills.description: Works out what to reorder and when, from what is actually selling: pulls sales history and stock on hand from Shopify, Square, NetSuite, or an uploaded CSV, computes 7-day and 28-day sales velocity per item, projects a conservative stockout date for each, sizes a 60-day reorder quantity, and drafts the purchase orders and vendor emails to cover it. Flags the money sitting still too — overstock, dead stock, and zero-velocity items, reported as slow movers to clear rather than things to buy more of. Seasonality is applied where the history supports it and named where it does not. Nothing is ordered and no vendor is emailed without approval. Reach for this whenever stock comes up — "what do I need to reorder," "am I going to run out," "what should I order this month," "we keep running out of filters," "how much cash is sitting in the warehouse," "what is not moving," or "draft a PO for my supplier."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 根据实际销售判断补什么货、何时补：从 Shopify、Square、NetSuite 或上传的 CSV 拉取销售历史和现有库存，按单品计算 7 天和 28 天销售速度，保守推算缺货日期，测算 60 天补货量，并起草采购订单和供应商邮件；同时标出积压、呆滞和零动销品，作为待清理的滞销品而非加购对象。季节性只在历史数据支持时应用，否则明确说明；未经批准不会下单、不会给供应商发邮件。当用户说「我该补什么货」「会不会断货」「滤芯老是断货」「仓库压了多少钱」「什么卖不动」「给供应商起草一份 PO」时使用。

skills.name: invoice-chase
skills.description: Drafts overdue-invoice reminder emails from the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) plus PayPal, Stripe, and Airwallex data, matched to each customer's payment history and tone (gentle for good customers, firm for repeat late payers). Sends via PayPal with owner approval; everything else queues as a mail draft, with the Airwallex hosted pay link included where one exists. Use when the user asks "who owes me money," mentions overdue invoices, or wants to follow up on unpaid invoices.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 基于账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books）及 PayPal、Stripe、Airwallex 数据起草逾期发票催款邮件，并按每位客户的付款历史调整语气（优质客户温和，惯常拖欠者严厉）。经用户批准后可通过 PayPal 发送，其余进入邮件草稿队列，有 Airwallex 托管支付链接的会一并附上。当用户问「谁欠我钱」、提到逾期发票或想跟进未付款项时使用。

skills.name: job-post-builder
skills.description: Builds end-to-end hiring packets — job post, structured interview guide with scoring rubric, and offer letter template — from a hiring brief. Triggers on: "help me hire", "we're hiring for", "write a job post", "job description", "JD", "open role", "create a job ad", "interview questions", "scoring rubric", "draft an offer letter", "send an offer", "make a hiring packet", or any request to recruit for a position. When in doubt, trigger — covers the full hiring workflow from job post through DocuSign envelope creation via browser. Does NOT screen or rank applicants.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 根据招聘需求生成完整招聘资料包：职位发布、带评分标准的结构化面试指南，以及录用通知书模板。当用户说「帮我招人」「我们在招……」「写一份职位发布」「职位描述」「JD」「开放岗位」「面试问题」「评分标准」「起草 offer」「发 offer」「做一套招聘资料」或任何招聘岗位的请求时使用，拿不准时也可触发；覆盖从职位发布到通过浏览器创建 DocuSign 信封的全流程，但不筛选、不排名求职者。

skills.name: lead-finder
skills.description: Builds a ranked list of prospects worth contacting. Works out the owner's ideal customer profile from the customers they already have, finds look-alike companies and the right contact at each, enriches them with firmographics and buying signals, scores them, and delivers the list as an XLSX, with an offer to also create the records in the CRM. Runs on Apollo when connected and falls back to web research plus an uploaded customer list when it isn't. Use this whenever the owner wants new prospects, a target list, or help finding customers — including phrasings like "who should I be calling," "find me more customers like my best ones," "build me a prospect list," "I need leads," "who else looks like Acme," or "help me find companies in this area that need what we do." Reach for it even when the owner describes the customer they want rather than asking for a list.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 生成值得联系的潜在客户排名清单：从现有客户推导理想客户画像，寻找相似企业及其对口联系人，补充企业信息和购买信号，打分后以 XLSX 交付，并可顺带在 CRM 中创建记录。已连接 Apollo 时用 Apollo，否则改用网络调研加上传的客户名单。当用户想要新客户、目标清单或找客户时使用，例如「我该给谁打电话」「找些像我最好客户那样的」「给我建一份潜客清单」「我需要线索」「还有谁像 Acme」「帮我找本地需要我们产品的公司」；即使只是描述想要的客户类型也适用。

skills.name: small-business-lead-triage
skills.description: Scores inbound HubSpot leads by engagement signals, company fit, and urgency markers, ranks the ones worth a call today with talking points, drafts the follow-ups, and proposes calendar times for the owner to book. Use when the owner asks to prioritize, score, or rank leads, asks "who should I call first," or asks about their pipeline. An ask that wants the ranked leads turned into a call list with time blocked on the calendar routes to /call-list, which runs this skill first and then books the time.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 按互动信号、公司匹配度和紧迫程度给 HubSpot 的入站线索打分，排出今天值得打电话的线索并附谈话要点，起草跟进消息，再提议日历时段供用户预约。当用户要求给线索排优先级、打分或排序，问「我该先给谁打电话」，或询问销售漏斗时使用；若还想把排好序的线索变成电话名单并在日历上占时间，走 /call-list，它会先运行这一技能再预约时间。

skills.name: marketing-monday
skills.description: Delivers the weekly growth briefing as one merged read — whether the growth engine is working, what customers are saying in public and private, what competitors actually changed, and the three growth actions worth taking this week. The growth twin of the Monday brief, chaining growth-pulse and review-reputation and adding a web-native competitor scan, merged into a single page rather than three reports. Offers to run on a weekly cadence once, and sets it up on a yes. Use this whenever the owner wants a recurring or one-off growth check, including phrasings like "how's marketing doing," "growth check for the week," "give me my Monday growth brief," "what should I be doing about growth this week," "are we winning or losing out there," or "set up a weekly marketing update." Reach for it when the owner asks how the business is growing rather than how it is paying its bills.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把每周增长简报合并成一页：增长引擎是否在运转、客户在公开和私下说了什么、竞争对手实际改了什么，以及本周值得做的三件增长行动。它是周一简报在增长侧的孪生版，串联 growth-pulse 和 review-reputation 并加上网络竞品扫描，合并为一页而非三份报告；会询问一次是否按周运行，同意后即设定。当用户想要一次性或定期的增长检查时使用，例如「营销做得怎么样」「给我周一增长简报」「我们在外面是赢是输」「设个每周营销更新」；问生意增长得如何而非账单付得如何时也适用。

skills.name: monday-brief
skills.description: Runs the owner's Monday morning briefing as a two-link chain — business-pulse for the cross-connector snapshot of cash, sales, and pipeline, and report-builder for any saved KPI reports the owner has already defined — then reads the week ahead straight from Calendar and mail and merges all three parts into a single one-page Monday document, delivered per the owner's stored output preference. Requires no connectors and degrades gracefully, building from whatever of the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), Calendar, DocuSign, Expensify, Gmail or M365, HubSpot, PayPal, Ramp, RingEx Chat, Shopify, Slack, Stripe, and TikTok Ads is connected, or from pasted and uploaded data when none are. Trigger on "Monday brief," "start my week," "what do I need to know this week," "weekly briefing," "catch me up before Monday," or when the owner schedules a recurring start-of-week update.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 以两步链运行用户的周一晨间简报：business-pulse 给出现金、销售和销售漏斗的跨连接器快照，report-builder 运行用户已保存的 KPI 报表，再直接从 Calendar 和邮件读取未来一周安排，三者合并成一页周一文档，按用户存储的输出偏好交付。不强制要求连接器，可基于账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books）、Calendar、DocuSign、Expensify、Gmail 或 M365、HubSpot、PayPal、Ramp、RingEx Chat、Shopify、Slack、Stripe、TikTok Ads 中任意已接的部分生成，没有则用粘贴或上传的数据。当用户说「周一简报」「开启我的一周」「这周我需要知道什么」「每周简报」「周一前帮我补课」，或设定每周初的定期更新时使用。

skills.name: month-end-prep
skills.description: Reconciles the accounting ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) against PayPal, Shopify, Square, and Stripe settlements, flags transactions that need attention, suspicious duplicates, and missing receipts, then writes a plain-English P&L narrative and exports a close packet (xlsx + one-page PDF). This is the first link of the /close-month command; a request to close the month or the books routes there, and the command runs this skill before refreshing the forecast and distributing the packet. Use this skill directly only when the owner wants the reconciliation alone, with no forecast refresh and no distribution: "just reconcile, no packet," "what's missing from the books," "flag the duplicates and missing receipts," or "write the P&L narrative for this month."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 将会计账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books）与 PayPal、Shopify、Square、Stripe 的结算记录对账，标出需关注的交易、疑似重复和缺失票据，再用大白话撰写损益说明并导出月结资料包（xlsx 加一页 PDF）。这是 /close-month 命令的第一环：要求结月或结账的请求会走该命令，命令先运行这一步，再刷新预测、分发资料包。只在用户只要对账、不刷新预测也不分发时直接使用：「只对账，不要资料包」「账上缺什么」「标出重复项和缺的票据」「写这个月的损益说明」。

skills.name: outreach-composer
skills.description: Writes prospect outreach and follow-up sequences that sound like the owner wrote them, not like an AI did. Learns a voice profile from the owner's own sent mail, grounds every message in something specific about that prospect, builds the follow-up sequence behind it, queues every send for approval, and logs each touch to the CRM. Runs draft-only when no mail connector is available, so the copy can be pasted anywhere. Use this whenever the owner needs to reach out to prospects or customers — including phrasings like "write this cold email," "draft a follow-up," "reach out to these leads," "what do I say to them," "I need a sequence for this list," "nudge the people who didn't reply," or "write it but don't make it sound like a robot." Reach for it whenever outreach copy is the deliverable, even for a single message.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 撰写像用户亲笔写的、没有 AI 味的潜客触达和跟进序列：从用户自己的已发邮件学习语气风格，每封都落在该潜客的具体细节上，配套构建后续跟进序列，所有发送均排队等待批准，并把每次接触记入 CRM。没有邮件连接器时只出草稿，可粘贴到任何地方。当用户需要联系潜在客户或客户时使用，例如「写这封冷邮件」「起草一封跟进」「联系这些线索」「我该跟他们说什么」「给这份名单做个序列」「催一下没回复的人」「写得别像机器人」；哪怕只写一封也适用。

skills.name: pay-the-bills
skills.description: Works the bill pile from the AP inbox all the way to a staged payment run — reads and codes every bill, then checks the cash position before a dollar is committed, then stages the run for one-click approval and keeps the books tidy for close. Coding and paying are two separate decisions with two separate approvals, and the cash check sits between them on purpose. Runs on the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) and a mail connector (Gmail or M365), deepens with Expensify and Ramp, and works from uploaded PDFs or phone photos with the run sheet exported for manual entry. Use it when the owner says "pay the bills," "the bills are piling up," "what do I owe," "who needs to get paid this week," "can I afford to pay these," or forwards a stack of vendor invoices.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 从 AP 邮箱一路处理到暂存付款批次：读取并编码每张账单，在承诺任何一分钱之前先检查现金状况，再暂存批次供一键审批，并为月结保持账目整洁。编码和付款是两个独立决定、两次独立审批，现金检查有意放在两者之间。运行于账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books）和邮件连接器（Gmail 或 M365），Expensify 和 Ramp 可增强；也可处理上传的 PDF 或手机照片，导出付款单供手工录入。当用户说「付账单」「账单堆起来了」「我欠谁的钱」「这周该付谁」「这些我付得起吗」，或转发一叠供应商发票时使用。

skills.name: payroll-prep
skills.description: Gets payroll ready to run without anyone getting shorted: pulls timesheets from Gusto, QuickBooks Payroll, or an uploaded spreadsheet, totals regular, overtime, and PTO hours by person, flags every anomaly it finds — missed punches, overtime spikes, rate changes, mid-period hires and terminations, hours off the schedule — and stages the run for the owner to approve line by line before a dollar moves. Anomalies are always raised, never quietly corrected. Once the owner runs it, the journal posts to the ledger or goes to the bookkeeper. Reach for this whenever payroll comes up at all — "run payroll," "payroll is due," "check the timecards," "did everyone clock out," "how many hours did the crew put in," "why is payroll so high this week," "I need to pay the guys Friday" — and use it after cash-flow-snapshot when the owner is worried about whether payroll clears.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把工资发放准备妥当、不让任何人少拿：从 Gusto、QuickBooks Payroll 或上传的表格拉取工时表，按人汇总正常、加班和带薪假工时，标出所有异常（漏打卡、加班激增、费率变动、期中入离职、排班外工时），并暂存工资批次供用户逐行审批后再动钱。异常一律提示，绝不悄悄修正，用户执行后凭证记入账套或交给记账员。任何涉及工资的话题都可使用，例如「发工资」「工资到期了」「核一下考勤卡」「团队这周干了多少小时」「这周工资怎么这么高」「周五要给工人发钱」；用户担心工资能否过账时，可在 cash-flow-snapshot 之后使用。

skills.name: plan-payroll
skills.description: Runs the payroll-confidence chain end to end — forecasts cash across the payroll window with cash-flow-snapshot, ranks and drafts overdue-invoice reminders with invoice-chase to close any gap, then assembles timesheets, flags every anomaly, and stages the run with payroll-prep. On Gusto the run is staged for the owner to submit; on QuickBooks Payroll, or with no payroll system, the last step is a validated run sheet the owner keys in. This chain never presses the payroll button. Builds on the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), with Gmail or M365, PayPal, Square, Stripe, and either Gusto or QuickBooks Payroll adding detail, and falls back to CSV and timesheet uploads. Use it whenever payroll is the worry, including "can I make payroll," "payroll is due Friday," "plan payroll," "will I have enough to pay the crew," or "I need to run payroll but money is tight." Accepts optional horizon and payroll-date arguments.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 端到端运行「工资信心链」：用 cash-flow-snapshot 预测发薪窗口内的现金，用 invoice-chase 对逾期发票排序并起草催款以补缺口，再用 payroll-prep 汇总工时、标出所有异常并暂存工资批次。接 Gusto 时批次暂存由用户提交；用 QuickBooks Payroll 或没有工资系统时，最终输出经校验的工资单供用户录入，这条链绝不会替用户按下发薪按钮。基于账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books），Gmail 或 M365、PayPal、Square、Stripe 及 Gusto 或 QuickBooks Payroll 可补充细节，否则用 CSV 和工时表上传。当用户担心工资时使用，例如「工资发得出来吗」「周五要发工资」「规划一下工资」「钱紧但得发工资」；支持可选的预测期和发薪日参数。

skills.name: proposal-builder
skills.description: Turns whatever came out of a discovery conversation — a call transcript, a voice memo, jobsite photos, an RFP document, a set of drawings, or scrappy notes — into a branded, costed proposal, estimate, or statement of work built on the owner's own templates and historical pricing. Routes it for signature and triggers the deposit invoice once it's accepted. Works entirely from uploaded files when no connector is available, producing DOCX and PDF the owner can send themselves. Use this whenever a quote, bid, estimate, proposal, or SOW is the deliverable — including phrasings like "write this up for them," "put together a quote," "I need to bid this job," "turn my notes into a proposal," "respond to this RFP," or "price this out." Reach for it when the owner describes a job they just looked at, even without saying the word quote.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把发现阶段的任何素材（通话记录、语音备忘、工地照片、RFP 文件、图纸或零散笔记）变成基于用户自有模板和历史报价、带品牌和成本的方案书、报价单或工作说明书，再送签，接受后触发定金发票。没有连接器时完全基于上传文件工作，产出 DOCX 和 PDF 供用户自行发送。当报价、投标、估价、方案或 SOW 是交付物时使用，例如「帮他们写一份」「做个报价」「我要投这个活」「把笔记变成方案」「回复这份 RFP」「算一下价格」；用户描述刚看过的一个活儿时，即使没说「报价」也适用。

skills.name: reactivate
skills.description: Wins back customers who have quietly stopped buying — finds the ones whose gap has stretched past their own normal rhythm or who are showing churn signals, ranks them by what the relationship was worth, drafts a win-back message per customer in the owner's voice, and sends and logs only what the owner approves. Chains review-reputation, outreach-composer, and crm-autopilot, and keeps the rule that the first touch acknowledges the gap without pitching. Use this whenever the owner is worried about customers drifting away, including phrasings like "who hasn't ordered in a while," "win back my old customers," "which customers have gone quiet," "we lost some regulars," "reach out to the people who stopped calling," or "how do I get them back." Reach for it when the owner names a customer they have not heard from, as readily as for a full win-back campaign.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 赢回悄悄不再下单的客户：找出购买间隔超出自身正常节奏或出现流失信号的客户，按关系价值排序，以用户口吻为每位客户起草挽回消息，只发送和记录用户批准的内容。串联 review-reputation、outreach-composer 和 crm-autopilot，并坚持首次触达只认可久未联系、不推销。当用户担心客户流失时使用，例如「谁好久没下单了」「把老客户找回来」「哪些客户没动静了」「我们丢了几个常客」「联系一下不再打电话来的人」「怎么把他们找回来」；提到某个失联客户时同样适用。

skills.name: report-builder
skills.description: Turns a plain-English description of a recurring report into a real, repeatable report — defines the metrics, pulls them from whatever data sources are connected, delivers a chat summary plus an XLSX workbook, and saves the definition so the same report reruns on demand or on a schedule. Handles anything from "sales by location versus last year" to AR aging to labor as a percentage of revenue. Works fully from an uploaded CSV or XLSX when no connector is available. Use this whenever the owner asks for a report, dashboard, KPI pack, metrics summary, or recurring numbers — including phrasings like "can you track this every week," "I need to see these numbers monthly," "build me a report on," "same report as last time," or "put together a KPI dashboard." Reach for it even when the owner names the metrics without using the word report.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把一句大白话描述的定期报表变成真正可重复运行的报表：定义指标，从已连接的数据源抓取，交付聊天摘要和 XLSX 工作簿，并保存定义以便按需或定时重跑。从「各门店销售同比」到应收账龄、人工占收入比例都能做；没有连接器时可完全基于上传的 CSV 或 XLSX。当用户要报表、看板、KPI 包、指标汇总或定期数据时使用，例如「能每周跟踪这个吗」「我要每月看这些数字」「给我做一份关于……的报表」「和上次一样的报表」「做个 KPI 看板」；只说了指标没说「报表」也适用。

skills.name: report-pack
skills.description: Delivers the owner's custom recurring report pack on a set cadence — runs the saved report definition from report-builder, wraps it in a business-pulse snapshot so the numbers have context, and hands over one chat summary plus the workbook. Defined once, then delivered on schedule without being asked again. Runs on any single connected data source, or entirely from an uploaded CSV or XLSX. Use it when the owner asks for their report pack, their weekly or monthly numbers, "send me the usual report," "run my report pack," "set this up to come every Monday," or "I want these numbers on a schedule."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 按固定节奏交付用户定制的定期报表包：运行 report-builder 保存的报表定义，外加一份 business-pulse 快照给数字提供背景，交付一份聊天摘要和工作簿。定义一次，之后按计划自动送达，无需再问。可基于任意单个已连接数据源运行，也可完全基于上传的 CSV 或 XLSX。当用户要报表包、每周或每月数据，或说「把常规报表发我」「跑一下我的报表包」「设成每周一自动来」「我要定期收到这些数字」时使用。

skills.name: restock
skills.description: Turns what is actually selling into a reorder decision and gets it all the way into the books — computes sales velocity and conservative stockout dates per item, sizes the reorder, drafts the purchase order and the vendor email, and then stages the matching entry so the bill matches against the PO when it arrives. Flags the money sitting still too, so dead stock gets cleared instead of reordered. Runs on Shopify, Square, or an uploaded sales and stock CSV, and deepens with QuickBooks, Gmail or M365, Calendar, and NetSuite. No PO is sent and no vendor is emailed without approval. Use it when the owner says "what do I need to reorder," "am I going to run out," "restock," "we keep running out of filters," "draft a PO for my supplier," or "how much cash is sitting in the warehouse."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把实际销售情况变成补货决定并一路记入账目：按单品计算销售速度和保守缺货日期，测算补货量，起草采购订单和供应商邮件，再暂存对应分录，等账单到达时与 PO 匹配；同时标出压着的资金，让呆滞库存被清理而非再次补货。运行于 Shopify、Square 或上传的销售及库存 CSV，QuickBooks、Gmail 或 M365、Calendar、NetSuite 可增强。未经批准不会发出 PO、不会给供应商发邮件。当用户说「我该补什么货」「会不会断货」「补货」「滤芯老是断」「给供应商起草一份 PO」「仓库压了多少钱」时使用。

skills.name: review-reputation
skills.description: Watches what customers are saying in public and in private, then does something about it. Aggregates Google, Yelp, and Facebook reviews alongside disputes, tickets, and email into themes backed by verbatim quotes; drafts a reply to every review in the owner's own voice for approval; spots customers who have gone quiet or look likely to leave; and drafts win-back offers for the ones worth keeping. With Shopify connected, order and fulfillment patterns become a sentiment signal too. Works from pasted or exported reviews when nothing is connected. Use this whenever the owner asks about reviews, ratings, reputation, complaints, or repeat business — including "what are people saying about us," "did we get any bad reviews," "how do I respond to this one-star," "our rating dropped," "which customers have gone quiet," "who hasn't ordered in a while," "how do I win them back," or "are customers happy."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 盯住客户在公开和私下的评价，并付诸行动：汇总 Google、Yelp、Facebook 评价及纠纷、工单和邮件，归纳为有原话佐证的主题；以用户口吻为每条评价起草回复待批准；识别沉寂或可能流失的客户，并为值得挽留的起草挽回优惠。接入 Shopify 后，订单和履约模式也成为情绪信号；没有连接器时可处理粘贴或导出的评价。当用户问评价、评分、口碑、投诉或回头客时使用，例如「大家怎么评价我们」「有差评吗」「这条一星怎么回」「评分掉了」「哪些客户没动静了」「怎么把他们找回来」「客户满意吗」。

skills.name: seo-ai-visibility
skills.description: Audits and fixes both halves of being found — classic search and AI answers. Search side: rankings, site structure, page speed, titles and descriptions, and content that answers what customers search for. AI side: whether assistant crawlers can reach the site, pages render without JavaScript, an llms.txt file, schema.org data, and presence in the directories assistants read. For online stores it also runs a bulk catalog cleanup, rewriting product titles, descriptions, alt text, and SEO fields in approved batches. Works on any public website with no connector. Use this whenever the owner talks about being found online, including "nobody finds us on Google," "how do I show up in ChatGPT," "make my website AI friendly," "SEO audit," "GEO," "AEO," "AI search visibility," "my competitor ranks above me," "fix my product listings," or "I asked an AI about my industry and we weren't in the answer."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 审计并修复「被找到」的两半：传统搜索（排名、站点结构、页面速度、标题与描述、回答客户搜索问题的内容）和 AI 问答（AI 爬虫能否访问、页面无 JavaScript 是否可渲染、llms.txt、schema.org 数据、是否收录于 AI 助手参考的目录）。对网店还能批量清理商品目录，分批审批后重写标题、描述、替代文本和 SEO 字段。任何公开网站均可使用，无需连接器。当用户谈到线上曝光时使用，例如「Google 上没人找到我们」「怎么在 ChatGPT 里出现」「让网站对 AI 友好」「SEO 审计」「GEO」「AEO」「竞争对手排在我前面」「修一下我的商品列表」「问 AI 我们行业，答案里没有我们」。

skills.name: smb-onboard
skills.description: Claude as the trainer. Walks an SMB owner through connecting their first two tools, runs one recipe to prove immediate value, interviews them about their business (industry, size, top three headaches), stores that context persistently so every other skill benefits, and sets a weekly check-in cadence. Use when the owner is getting started or says any of: "set me up," "setup," "help me get set up," "get started," "help me get started," "get me started," "what can you do," "I'm new to this," or is in their first session.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 由 Claude 担任培训师：带小微企业主连接头两个工具，跑一个流程立刻见效，访谈其业务（行业、规模、三大痛点），把这些背景持久保存供所有其他技能共用，并设定每周回顾节奏。当用户刚开始使用，或说「帮我设置」「设置」「帮我上手」「开始」「你能做什么」「我是新手」，或处于首次会话时使用。

skills.name: smb-router
skills.description: The front door to the Small Business plugin. Listens to what the owner needs right now — vague or specific — and routes them to the best skill or slash command for the moment. Also serves as a guide: explains what's available, suggests what to try next, and adapts recommendations based on stored business context. Trigger whenever the owner asks "what can you do," "help me with my business," "what should I focus on," "I don't know where to start," or any open-ended business request that doesn't clearly match a single skill.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: Small Business 插件的总入口：听用户此刻的需求（无论模糊还是具体），把他们引导到最合适的技能或斜杠命令；同时充当向导，说明有哪些功能、建议接下来试什么，并根据已存储的企业背景调整推荐。当用户问「你能做什么」「帮我打理生意」「我该关注什么」「不知道从哪开始」，或提出任何与单个技能不明显对应的开放式经营请求时使用。

skills.name: social-content-engine
skills.description: Runs the owner's content operation as a standing thing rather than a one-off: keeps a rolling posting calendar, learns the owner's voice, generates on-brand Canva graphics, writes captions that sound like them, repurposes one asset into every channel format, and stages posts for approval instead of publishing on its own. Pulls product photos and prices from Shopify when connected; with no connectors, drafts the calendar and asset briefs for manual posting. Use this whenever the owner talks about posting, content, or social — including "I need to post more," "we've gone quiet on Instagram," "what should we post this month," "make the content," "give me a month of posts," "write this in my voice," "repurpose this," or "set up our content calendar." Reach for it for a single post as readily as for a full quarter. One handoff: a finished, approved campaign brief goes to canva-creator; this skill owns the standing operation.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 把用户的内容运营做成常设机制而非一次性任务：维护滚动发布日历，学习用户语气，生成符合品牌的 Canva 图片，撰写像用户本人的文案，把一个素材改编成各渠道格式，并暂存帖子待审批而不自行发布。接入 Shopify 时可拉取商品图片和价格；没有连接器时起草日历和素材简报供手动发布。当用户谈到发帖、内容或社交媒体时使用，例如「我得多发点」「Instagram 好久没更新了」「这个月该发什么」「给我一个月的帖子」「搭个内容日历」，单条帖子和整季度都适用；已批准的成品活动简报则交给 canva-creator 执行。

skills.name: speed-to-lead
skills.description: Makes sure no inbound lead goes unanswered. Watches web forms, the shared inbox, and the CRM for new inquiries, qualifies each one against the owner's criteria, drafts a reply in the owner's voice with real meeting times for the owner to approve and send, routes anything hot to a human right away, and logs the whole thing to the CRM. Never sends on its own. Built to run on a schedule so overnight inquiries are drafted and sorted by morning, and works from forwarded or pasted inquiries when no connector is available. Use this whenever the owner is worried about inbound leads or response time — including phrasings like "leads are going cold," "did anyone answer that inquiry," "I keep missing form submissions," "nothing falls through the cracks," "handle my inbound," "respond to this lead," or "we lose people because nobody gets back fast enough." Reach for it for a single unanswered inquiry as readily as for a standing setup.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 确保没有一条入站线索无人回复：监控网页表单、共享收件箱和 CRM 的新咨询，按用户标准逐一筛选，以用户口吻起草带真实会议时间的回复供用户批准发送，热门线索立即转给人工，全程记入 CRM，绝不自行发送。可定时运行，让夜间咨询在早晨前已分好类、写好草稿；没有连接器时可处理转发或粘贴的咨询。当用户担心入站线索或响应速度时使用，例如「线索凉了」「我老漏掉表单提交」「处理我的入站」「回复这条线索」「我们因为回得慢丢客户」；单条未回复咨询和常设配置都适用。

skills.name: tax-prep
skills.description: Prepares tax materials as a two-link chain — month-end-prep confirms the books are closed and reconciled first, then tax-season-organizer calculates the quarterly estimated payment or builds the year-end 1099-NEC list and accountant packet from those closed numbers. Requires a ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books); uses Gusto, PayPal, and Stripe when connected, else CSV upload. US federal tax math; a non-US business gets the closed-books packet. Prep material for a CPA, never tax advice, nothing filed. Trigger on "quarterly taxes," "estimated tax payment," "how much should I set aside," "1099s," "1099-NEC," "W-9s," "year-end tax prep," "get my books ready for my accountant," any phrasing that suggests a tax deadline is coming, or a question about net profit or YTD income that sounds like worry about a tax bill. An owner who says the period's books are already closed routes to tax-season-organizer directly.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 两步链准备税务材料：month-end-prep 先确认账目已结清对账，tax-season-organizer 再基于结清数据计算季度预缴税额，或生成年末 1099-NEC 名单和会计师资料包。需要账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books），已连接时用 Gusto、PayPal、Stripe，否则上传 CSV。按美国联邦税计算，非美国企业只得到结账资料包；只是给 CPA 的准备材料，不是税务建议，也不会申报。当用户说「季度税」「预缴税」「该留多少钱」「1099」「1099-NEC」「W-9」「年末报税准备」「把账准备好给会计」，或任何暗示报税期将至、像在担心税单的净利润/年初至今收入问题时使用；用户说账已结清的，直接走 tax-season-organizer。

skills.name: tax-season-organizer
skills.description: Prepares tax-season materials for the owner's accountant, not tax advice. US federal tax; a non-US business gets its closed-books packet instead. Two modes: (1) quarterly estimated tax from YTD net income in the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books); (2) year-end 1099 prep, scanning the ledger, PayPal, and Stripe for contractors paid over USD 600 into a 1099-NEC list with missing W-9 flags. Any tax request routes first to /tax-prep, which confirms the books are closed and reconciled before running this skill. Use this skill directly only when the owner says the period's books are already closed: "books are closed, now do the 1099s," "run the quarterly estimate off the closed numbers," or "just the contractor W-9 list."
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 为用户的会计师准备报税季材料，不是税务建议。按美国联邦税，非美国企业改为提供结账资料包。两种模式：一是根据账套（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books）中年初至今净利润计算季度预缴税；二是年末 1099 准备，扫描账套、PayPal 和 Stripe 中支付超过 600 美元的承包商，生成 1099-NEC 名单并标出缺 W-9 的。任何税务请求先走 /tax-prep，由它确认账目已结清对账后再运行这一步。只在用户说账已结清时直接使用：「账结了，做 1099 吧」「用结清的数字算季度预缴」「只要承包商 W-9 清单」。

skills.name: ticket-deflector
skills.description: Reads a forwarded customer email or ticket, pulls order and refund status from a payments connector (PayPal, Square, or Stripe) or Shopify, account history from the CRM, and open tickets from a support desk (Zoho Desk), drafts a tone-matched reply in the owner's writing voice, and can issue a refund through the payments connector with explicit owner approval. With Shopify connected it also runs a proactive order-triage mode that surfaces orders needing attention — unfulfilled past the promised window, payment problems, pending refunds, stuck shipments — and drafts the next action for each before the customer has to ask. Use when the user says "draft a response," "answer this customer," "where's my order," "I want a refund," "check my orders," or "anything about to blow up."
skills.compatibility: Works from pasted or forwarded text alone. Atlassian, HubSpot, Mail, PayPal, Shopify, Square, Stripe, Zoho Desk all optional and deepen the workflow.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.description_zh: 读取转发来的客户邮件或工单，从支付连接器（PayPal、Square、Stripe）或 Shopify 拉取订单和退款状态，从 CRM 拉取账户历史，从 Zoho Desk 拉取未结工单，以用户的写作口吻起草语气匹配的回复，并可在用户明确批准后通过支付连接器退款。接入 Shopify 后还有主动订单分诊模式，找出需要关注的订单（超过承诺时限未发货、支付异常、待退款、物流卡住），在客户开口前为每单起草下一步动作。当用户说「起草回复」「回复这位客户」「我的订单呢」「我要退款」「查一下我的订单」或「有什么快要出事的」时使用。
